decisions.rationale: The complete MDO glossary directly attests sutra. LAS quotation-source grammar does not separately establish the expanded makes mention verb; no356 GSUNGS is borrowed.
First MTHONG BA is the true seeing being denied in the first group, not either quoted see or the final negative experience. Its complete glossary directly supports see.
The explicit first four-kind list supplies this first hear. The later negative four-kind list is abbreviated in Tibetan and does not supply a second THOS PA.
The full cognitive verb supplies the first know among actual experiences. The later know is an expansion of SOGS and stays unbanked as a separate word.
The explicit first sensory list supplies this sense, supported by the complete RTOGS PA glossary and surrounding fourfold explanation.
First source BZHI counts the actual four kinds being contradicted. It owns about four different, not the earlier four types of false statements.
This LA makes the actual experience list the object of the false statements, rendered the first about. It is not either supplied where.
First explicit MA negates the first quoted claim. Its owner is the permitted negative contraction inside didn’t; the printed ASCII apostrophe is retained and subword is explicit.
First bare MTHONG is the quoted denial, after its own MA. It owns see inside the first quote, not the actual experience later in English.

The first quotative ZHES introduces the stated denial and is rendered say. This is local quotation grammar at depth6; the mined three principal paths gloss is unrelated and not treated as an attestation of say.
First enumerative SOGS owns the complete first and so on following the quoted denial. Do not split this formula into supplied conjunction fragments.
Second source BZHI counts the first four false statements and owns the numbered1) four types. This differs from the first source count of actual experiences.
The DANG connecting the two contrasting sets owns the explicit and before item2. Final source DANG instead leads into the next segment and is not this coordinator.
Second MA negates the actual experiences in the second set. It owns the final didn’t, outside quotation marks, and not the first quoted denial.
Middle MTHONG is the actual seeing that did not happen in the second set. It selects the last see, paired locally with its own negative.
Third source BZHI counts the second set of actual non-experiences, rendered another four kinds. The abbreviated other senses are not invented source words.
Second LA owns the second about, linking the second quoted assertion to its four contrary actual conditions.
Last source MTHONG is the positive quoted assertion made contrary to the second actual negative condition. Its exact English quote is distinct from did see outside quotes.
Last ZHES introduces the second quoted assertion and owns its say. The middle ZHES merely labels the actual negative examples and has no additional printed say.
Last SOGS owns the second and so on following the positive quote. Its whole enumerative formula is depth6.
Fourth source BZHI counts the second group of false assertions and owns item2) four types. All four counts have explicit roles and separate ranges.
The complete glossary directly attests child, including a non-arya sense. The bracketed selflessness explanation is editorial expansion, not additional source words.

The local named verbal conventions are rendered expressions. Complete linked masters include deceptive/conventional senses; verbal-designation reference material and this local list support the noun, not a claimed HGM expressions gloss.
The explicit eight totals the two four-statement groups. The single source count owns the heading eight, without taking any bracketed explanation.
